item.title: Immigration officials plan to spend $38.3 billion to boost detention capacity to 92,000 beds
item.description: ICE plans 16 regional processing centers with a population of 1,000 to 1,500 detainees.

item.title: Asking Eric: Son judges parents’ marijuana use
item.description: A retired couple feels judged by their adult child for their legalized marijuana habit, while another reader is at her wit's end over a sister who lies about everything from her education to having non-existent children. Asking Eric explores how to set boundaries and maintain respect.

item.title: Survey: More than 2 in 5 Americans believe financial secrets are at least as bad as cheating
item.description: Bigger secrets can impact relationships — and livelihoods.

item.title: Some Valentine’s Day tips for anyone seeking the perfect match on four wheels
item.description: Edmunds identified five vehicles with distinct personality traits.

item.title: Recipe: Make these delicious S’Mores Brownies for Valentine’s Day
item.description: Chocolate brownies are baked on a graham cracker crust and then topped with miniature marshmallows.

item.title: Get into national parks free on Feb. 16 — but there’s a catch
item.description: Parks will be free to enter for U.S. legal residents only.

item.title: Windsor’s Dominick Serrano wins for UNC Bears wrestling in team’s loss to Wyoming
item.description: Serrano, ranked 11th at 133 pounds, scored a major decision with a 15-3 victory over No. 23 Luke Willochell at Bank of Colorado Arena in Greeley. Serrano's win was one of three for the Bears in the Big XII Conference dual against the 24th ranked Cowboys.

item.title: UNC Bears men’s basketball wins 6th straight Big Sky Conference game, sweeps weekend homestand
item.description: “We’re trending in the right direction, playing well,” UNC coach Steve Smiley said. “Going back to when we were not playing well, we were losing close games. Our guys have stayed the course day after day.”

item.title: CSU Rams rally past Wyoming in final minutes to claim home Border War victory
item.description: With the win, the Rams improved to 15-10 overall and 6-8 in the Mountain West Conference
